{npc:Mr Morris}, at the Adventurer's Outpost in Dawnport, needs help with his investigation. He offers 3 collection missions (amulet, logbook and herbs), 3 hunting missions (trolls, goblins and minotaurs) and also the search for the dormitory key. Each of the 7 missions gives 50 gold coins, 350 in total.
Mr Morris needs help with his investigation.
Mr Morris, 2nd floor of the Adventurer's Outpost
Level 2 to 20 (only exists in Dawnport). Recommended level 2.
Recommended: food, {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions} or {item:Health Potion|Health Potions}, {item:Mana Potion|Mana Potions} and {item:Antidote Rune} if you are a high enough level.
you can keep one of the two dormitory keys
You don't need to ask for the missions beforehand: you can start killing or collecting things right away. But talk to Mr Morris to find out what is left.
Do missions together: the log book is in the troll cave (troll mission), and the herb is near one of the entrances to the minotaur cave and the Woblin cave.
The Adventurer's Outpost has ramps for each vocation: west (Sorcerer), east (Paladin), south (Druid). The guide uses these names to help you find your way.

Go up to the 2nd floor of the {wiki:Adventurer's Outpost}, right above {npc:Inigo}, and talk to {npc:Mr Morris}: {key:hi}, {key:quest}. He gives you the choice between {key:fetch} (collect things) and {key:kill} (kill monsters). There is also the {key:key} mission.

Go down into the cave right beneath the Outpost, through the holes next to the west ramp (Sorcerer) or the east ramp (Paladin). At the **south** end of the cave there is a {item:Skeleton (Item)|human skeleton} on top of a {item:Hiding the Amulet (Book)|Piece of Paper}. Read the paper: the amulet was hidden on the beach.

Leave the cave through the hole you came down, going up with the {item:Rope}, and leave the Outpost through the **south** exit (Druid side). On the ground floor walk a little **east** and then **south** to the beach (you can also swim). Use the {item:Shovel} on the ground **3 times** to find the {item:Strange Amulet}.
Say {key:log book} to {npc:Mr Morris} and {key:yes}. The trolls stole the first log book.

Leave the Outpost through the **south** (Druid) or the **east** (Paladin). On the Paladin side head south of the ramp to the cave; on the Druid side head west. Go down to the **last floor** and fight your way to the **northwest** end of the cave.
At the end you may find a {creature:Troll Marauder}.

**Don't climb the ladders**: walk **east** across what looks like a bridge and open the chest. Inside is the {item:Torn Log Book}. To leave, go back the same way to the cave entrance, climb up the floors you came down and use the {item:Rope} on the entrance hole to return to the surface, next to the Outpost.
Bridge and chest with the Torn Log Book
Take the {item:Torn Log Book} to {npc:Mr Morris} ({key:log book}).
A log book you didn't pick up yourself doesn't work: Mr Morris says it isn't legible and tells you to find it yourself.
Say {key:herbs} to {npc:Mr Morris} and {key:yes}. Look for a bush with bright yellow buds, in light greyish-brown sand, surrounded by fireflies.

The herb is on the **west** side of Dawnport, on the ground floor, near {npc:Woblin}'s cave and one of the entrances to the minotaur cave. It looks like {item:Jungle Grass}. Use the {item:Dawnfire Herb Plant}: you get *"You harvested some of the herb's flower buds. Bring them to Morris for a reward."*
You can do this at the same time as the Plus Minos A Few mission.
Go back to {npc:Mr Morris} and say {key:herb}.
Say {key:key} to {npc:Mr Morris} and {key:yes}. The dormitory key has gone missing.

You can ask about the {key:key} to the other Outpost NPCs ({npc:Plunderpurse}, {npc:Garamond}, {npc:Ser Tybald}, {npc:Hamish}, {npc:Richard}, {npc:Coltrayne}, {npc:Oressa}), but the one who gives you the lead is {npc:Inigo}: he saw the goblin Woblin eyeing the key. Woblin lives in a cave in the **west** of the island.

Bring a {item:Fishing Rod} and 1 {item:Worm}. Leave the Outpost to the **west** (Sorcerer ramp) and go down to the ground floor by the next ramp to the west. Walk **north** to a staircase and a bridge, go down to the ground floor again and go to the ramp by the water (**not** the shovel hole). Follow the cave until you find {npc:Woblin}.
You can share the rod with a friend, but each one needs their own worm.
Say {key:hi}, {key:precious} and {key:reward}. He wants you to catch his arch-enemy, the fish {item:Old Nasty}.
Use the {item:Fishing Rod} in the lake next to Woblin until you catch {item:Old Nasty}.
Swap the fish for the key

Say {key:Old Nasty} to {npc:Woblin} and {key:yes}. You get the {item:Key 0010}. To leave, go back through the cave to the ramp by the water where you came in and return to the Outpost the same way (staircase and bridge, then the west/Sorcerer ramp).
With the key, open the **southeast** room on the last floor of the Outpost. Inside the drawers, under the book, there is another {item:Key 0010}.
Give one of the keys to {npc:Mr Morris}: {key:key} and {key:yes}.
If you want to keep a key, **drop it on the floor before talking to him**, otherwise he takes both.

Kill **20** {creature:Mountain Troll|Mountain Trolls}. They are all over Dawnport's surface and in a big cave with two entrances (holes) right outside the Outpost, both closer to the **south** ramp than to the west and east ramps (there are 2 other holes closer to those ramps). The mission starts by itself when you kill a troll, or you can ask for it with {key:trolls}.

The cave has mostly Mountain Trolls and {creature:Troll-Trained Salamander|Troll-Trained Salamanders}, a lone {creature:Troll} near the end and stairs to two rooms: one with two {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and another with more salamanders and a {creature:Salamander Trainer}, a fast boss with lots of defence.
The cave's other entrance is around {coord:32074,31894,6}. Do this mission together with the Stolen Log Book. To leave the cave, go back to one of the entrance holes and go up with the {item:Rope}.

Kill **20** {creature:Muglex Clan Footman|Muglex Clan Footmen}. They live with {creature:Muglex Clan Scavenger|Scavengers} and {creature:Muglex Clan Assassin|Assassins} in a cave with 2 entrances. The nearest is right beneath the Outpost, on the **east** (Paladin) ramp side: go down the hole next to the ramp and then through another hole a few sqm to the **southeast**. The other entrance is to the east.
Second entrance (east): {coord:32111,31903,7}. To leave, go back to the holes you came down and use the {item:Rope} on each to go up to next to the Outpost's east ramp.

The area also has {creature:Lesser Fire Devil|Lesser Fire Devils}, {creature:Crazed Dwarf|Crazed Dwarves}, {creature:Troll Marauder|Troll Marauders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Spider|Spiders}.
Go back to {npc:Mr Morris} and say {key:goblins}.

Ask for the mission with {key:minotaur} and kill **20** {creature:Minotaur Bruiser|Minotaur Bruisers}. They are with {creature:Minotaur Poacher|Minotaur Poachers} in a cave with 2 entrances. The nearest is beneath the Outpost: go down the hole next to the west (Sorcerer) ramp and walk **northeast**, or down the hole next to the east (Paladin) ramp and walk **northwest**. The hole has a {item:Warning Sign}. The other entrance is to the west, near Woblin's cave and the Dawnfire Herb Plant.
West entrance: {coord:32035,31890,7}. Going with friends is recommended. To leave, go back to the hole you came in by (the one with the {item:Warning Sign}) and go up with the {item:Rope}.

The first floor only has Bruisers and Poachers, but the next one also has {creature:Minotaur Occultist|Minotaur Occultists}, {creature:Dawn Scorpion|Dawn Scorpions}, {creature:Brittle Skeleton|Brittle Skeletons}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Spider|Spiders}.
Go back to {npc:Mr Morris} and say {key:minotaur}.
In total you receive 350 gp: 50 for each of the 7 missions.
There are more dangers in Dawnport, but they can all be avoided.
